subject.title: refactor(sessions): replace ambient watch sentinels with provenance

question: Should OpenClaw accept the shared state schema v4 upgrade now, including the intentional behavior that older builds refuse an upgraded database?
rationale: This is a durable data-model and downgrade-compatibility choice; tests can validate mechanics but cannot determine whether the project wants this release boundary now.

options.title: Accept v4 with upgrade proof
options.body: Approve the schema boundary after reviewing redacted evidence that a legacy v3 database upgrades and retains the intended watch behavior.

options.title: Defer the schema migration
options.body: Keep the sentinel representation temporarily and pursue provenance only when maintainers are ready to accept the v4 downgrade boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept v4 with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Approve the schema boundary after reviewing redacted evidence that a legacy v3 database upgrades and retains the intended watch behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the immediately preceding ambient-watch implementation and authored this migration proposal.
